question: Under Directive 2009/54/EG, it is prohibited to market natural mineral water from one and the same spring under more than one trade description.

Should ‘trade description’ be considered synonymous with the term ‘brand/trade name’, a great deal of the more than 130 German mineral water springs would face a serious existential problem – almost all mineral water springs are used by multiple companies and the same sources are shared by many brands. A ban would be tantamount to factory closure.
What exactly is meant by the term ‘trade description’ in the directive?
answer: EN on behalf of the European Commission (17.6.

2024) Directive 2009/54/EC1 defines ‘natural mineral water’ as ‘microbiologically wholesome water, within the meaning of Article 5, originating in an underground water table or deposit and emerging from a spring tapped at one or more natural or bore exits’ and provides that it shall be prohibited to market natural mineral water from one and the same spring under more than one trade description.

The Court of Justice of the European Union in its judgement of 24 June 20152 provides the interpretation of the notion of ‘natural mineral water from one and the same spring’ under more than one trade description, according to which it must be interpreted as referring to natural mineral water that is drawn from one or more natural or bore exits, and which originates in one and the same underground water table or in one and the same underground deposit, where, at all those natural or bore exits, that water has identical characteristics, pursuant to the criteria specified in Annex I to Directive 2009/54/EC, which remain stable within the limits of natural fluctuation.

Member States are responsible for enforcement of EU law in the national legal order and shall monitor and verify that the relevant requirements are fulfilled by food business operators at all stages of production, processing and distribution.
1 Directive 2009/54/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council of 18 June 2009 on the exploitation and

marketing of natural mineral waters (Recast), OJ L 164, 26.6.2009, p. 45–58. 2 Case C-207/14. Judgment of the Court (Third Chamber) of 24 June 2015. Request for a preliminary ruling from the Vrhovno sodišče Republike Slovenije.
